developer.note: Developer can modify agent code and workspace tools, but not core deepcli or harmony_hub directly.

linguist.note: Linguist handles compression, naming, and CID; cannot touch agent execution code.

chronomancer.note: Chronomancer manages versioning and temporal data, not live agent code.

orchestrator.note: Orchestrator has broad access to coordinate agents.

default.note: Unknown roles are restricted to sandbox only.
